title: Paul McCartney live: Xcel Energy Center, Saint Paul | 2005
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Xcel Energy Center in Saint Paul, Minnesota, USA, on 26 October 2005.

It was the 20th show of the US Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between September and November 2005. This show was seen by 16,515 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at the Xcel Energy Center on 23 September 2002 for the Driving World Tour.
